head: Headway's app to find and book therapy climbs the App Store
dek: Headway lets you find, book and message therapists and psychiatrists, check costs and get telehealth care in one app. It was #39 in Health & Fitness among free apps on the US App Store on 3 November.
details: You can filter by specialty, treatment method, style, gender and more. The listing says 80,000+ clinicians in the US. It's made by Therapymatch and is free with in-app purchases.
means: If you're looking for a therapist in the US, you can search, compare costs and book from your phone.
todo: Check the cost with your insurance in the app before you book a session.
thumb_words: FIND A THERAPIST IN ONE APP
